mapper.select: /* CastExecutionMapper.isResultGroupingVerified */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CAST_CONTRACT WHERE CONTRACT_ID = 'RESULT_GROUP_V1' AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND EVIDENCE IS NOT NULL
/* CastExecutionMapper.lockAllocator */ SELECT LOCK_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_ID_LOCK WHERE LOCK_ID = 'EXECUTION' FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT SMLT_ID, MIN(SMLT_TYPE) AS SMLT_TYPE, MIN(EXCN_YMD) AS EXCN_YMD, MIN(TMNL_ID) AS TMNL_ID, MIN(SMLT_BGNG_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, MAX(SMLT_END_DT) AS SMLT_END_DT, MIN(FRST_RGTR_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_RGTR_ID, MIN(FRST_REG_DT) AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG GROUP BY SMLT_ID

SELECT U.SMLT_ID, 'WhatIf' AS SMLT_TYPE, U.EXCN_YMD, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN S.SMLT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Finished' WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'New' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Executing' END AS SMLT_STTS, U.QUEUE_DT AS SMLT_REQ_DT, NVL(S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, U.EXCT_DT) AS SMLT_BGNG_DT, CASE WHEN U.SMLT_STTS = 'Failed' THEN NVL(U.END_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT) ELSE S.SMLT_END_DT END AS SMLT_END_DT, U.FRST_RGTR_ID, U.FRST_REG_DT, NVL(S.TMNL_ID, 'P01') AS TMNL_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U LEFT JOIN () S ON S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID UNION ALL SELECT S.SMLT_ID, CASE WHEN S.SMLT_TYPE = 'Manual' THEN 'Manual' ELSE 'Auto' END AS SMLT_TYPE, S.EXCN_YMD, 'Finished' AS SMLT_STTS, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP(6)) AS SMLT_REQ_DT, S.SMLT_BGNG_DT, S.SMLT_END_DT, S.FRST_RGTR_ID, S.FRST_REG_DT, S.TMNL_ID FROM () S WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE U.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID)
mapper.update: /* CastExecutionMapper.markSaved */ MERGE INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CURRENT_SAVE T USING (SELECT #{scope.loginUserId} OWNER_USER_ID, #{scope.ymd} EXCN_YMD, #{scope.fcltTmnlId} TMNL_ID, #{area} AREA_CD FROM DUAL) S ON (T.OWNER_USER_ID = S.OWNER_USER_ID AND T.EXCN_YMD = S.EXCN_YMD AND T.TMNL_ID = S.TMNL_ID AND T.AREA_CD = S.AREA_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SAVE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (OWNER_USER_ID, EXCN_YMD, TMNL_ID, AREA_CD, SAVE_DT) VALUES (S.OWNER_USER_ID, S.EXCN_YMD, S.TMNL_ID, S.AREA_CD, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.insert: /* CastExecutionMapper.storeCondition */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_COND_SNAPSHOT (SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, AREA_CD, PAYLOAD) VALUES (#{smltId}, #{tmnlId}, #{area}, #{payload,jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.select: /* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveCondition */ SELECT PAYLOAD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_COND_SNAPSHOT WHERE SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND AREA_CD = #{area}
/* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveBaseSmltId */ SELECT MAX(SMLT_ID) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG WHERE EXCN_YMD = #{ymd} AND SMLT_TYPE = 'Auto'

/* CastExecutionMapper.reserveRsrcNo */ SELECT RSRC_NO FROM ( SELECT N.RSRC_NO FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(#{minNo} + LEVEL - 1, 'FM000') RSRC_NO FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{maxNo} - #{minNo} + 1 ) N CROSS JOIN ( SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(LAST_NO)), #{minNo} - 1) LAST_NO FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_ID_LOCK WHERE LOCK_ID = 'RSRC_' || #{kind} ) P WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSRC_LEASE L INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U ON U.SMLT_ID = L.SMLT_ID WHERE L.RSRC_KIND = #{kind} AND L.RSRC_NO = N.RSRC_NO AND (U.SMLT_STTS IN ('New', 'Executing') OR (U.SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID))) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR U WHERE DECODE(#{kind}, 'FS', U.FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID, 'PS', U.PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID) = #{kind} || N.RSRC_NO AND (U.SMLT_STTS IN ('New', 'Executing') OR (U.SMLT_STTS = 'Finished' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG S WHERE S.SMLT_ID = U.SMLT_ID))) ) ORDER BY MOD(MOD(TO_NUMBER(N.RSRC_NO) - P.LAST_NO - 1, #{maxNo} - #{minNo} + 1) + #{maxNo} - #{minNo} + 1, #{maxNo} - #{minNo} + 1) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: /* CastExecutionMapper.assignRsrcNo */ MERGE INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSRC_LEASE T USING (SELECT #{kind} RSRC_KIND, #{rsrcNo} RSRC_NO, #{smltId} SMLT_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.RSRC_KIND = S.RSRC_KIND AND T.RSRC_NO = S.RSRC_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (RSRC_KIND, RSRC_NO, SMLT_ID) VALUES (S.RSRC_KIND, S.RSRC_NO, S.SMLT_ID)
/* CastExecutionMapper.updateLastRsrcNo */ UPDATE PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_ID_LOCK SET LAST_NO = #{rsrcNo} WHERE LOCK_ID = 'RSRC_' || #{kind}
mapper.select: /* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveResultId */ SELECT SMLT_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_IDENTITY WHERE SOURCE_KEY = #{sourceKey}
/* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveResultHash */ SELECT PAYLOAD_HASH FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_IDENTITY WHERE SOURCE_KEY = #{sourceKey}
mapper.insert: /* CastExecutionMapper.insertResultIdentity */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_IDENTITY (SOURCE_KEY, SMLT_ID, PAYLOAD_HASH) VALUES (#{sourceKey}, #{smltId}, #{payloadHash})
mapper.select: /* CastExecutionMapper.hasModel */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_STNG WHERE SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND SMLT_MDL_SN = #{mdlSn}

/* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveInput */ SELECT S.PAYLOAD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_INPUT_SNAPSHOT S INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSRC_LEASE L ON L.SMLT_ID = S.SMLT_ID AND L.RSRC_KIND = DECODE(S.RESOURCE_TYPE, 'PropertySet', 'PS', 'FS') WHERE S.RESOURCE_ID = #{resourceId} AND S.RESOURCE_TYPE = #{type} AND ( (L.RSRC_KIND = 'PS' AND S.RESOURCE_ID = 'PS' || L.RSRC_NO) OR (L.RSRC_KIND = 'FS' AND S.RESOURCE_ID IN ( 'FS' || L.RSRC_NO, 'CA' || L.RSRC_NO, 'SBD' || L.RSRC_NO, 'FacilityOpeningTable_DepartureGate' || L.RSRC_NO, 'FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl' || L.RSRC_NO, 'FacilityOpeningTable_Immigration' || L.RSRC_NO, 'FacilityOpeningTable_TransferSecurityControl' || L.RSRC_NO )) )
/* CastExecutionMapper.retrieveResultGroup */ SELECT SMLT_ID FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_GROUP WHERE GROUP_KEY = #{groupKey}
mapper.insert: /* CastExecutionMapper.insertResultGroup */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_GROUP (GROUP_KEY, SMLT_ID) VALUES (#{groupKey}, #{smltId})
mapper.update: /* CastExecutionMapper.syncHistory */ MERGE INTO PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_FLFMT_HSTRY H USING (SELECT E.* FROM () E WHERE E.SMLT_ID = #{smltId}) M ON (H.SMLT_ID = M.SMLT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET H.SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD = CASE M.SMLT_STTS WHEN 'Finished' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'Failed' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END, H.SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT = M.SMLT_BGNG_DT, H.SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT = M.SMLT_END_DT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SMLT_ID, SMLT_TYPE, SMLT_FLFMT_STTS_CD, SMLT_FLFMT_BGNG_DT, SMLT_FLFMT_END_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT) VALUES (M.SMLT_ID, M.SMLT_TYPE, CASE M.SMLT_STTS WHEN 'Finished' THEN 'DONE' WHEN 'Failed' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RUNNING' END, M.SMLT_BGNG_DT, M.SMLT_END_DT, M.FRST_RGTR_ID, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
